sources.title: Attention (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Attention mechanism, overview In machine learning, attention is a method that determines the importance of each component in a sequence relative to the other components in that sequence. In natural language processing, importance is represented by "soft" weights assigned to each word in a sentence. sources.title: Transformer (deep learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Knowledge distillation is a method for training a smaller model, called a "student", to reproduce the output behavior of a larger "teacher" model. In transformer models, the student can be trained using the teacher's output probability distribution, intermediate representations, or attention patterns in addition to the original training labels.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need Explained - The Paper That Changed AI
sources.snippet: What is the Transformer architecture? The Transformer is an AI architecture introduced in the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need." It processes all input simultaneously using attention mechanisms, rather than word by word like older models, enabling faster training and far better understanding of context and long-range relationships.
